lastCompletedStory.title: Update scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md 'Your Task' steps to drop full-prd self-select; re-embed vendor

nextStoryContext: US-002 shipped: both scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md and templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md's 'Your Task' numbered steps now state that the story to implement (id/title/description/priority/requires/acceptanceCriteria) plus branchName arrives pre-selected in the spawn prompt (US-001's buildImplementerTaskPrompt), instead of instructing the agent to read prd.json in full and pick the highest-priority passes:false story. The old step 5 ('Pick the highest priority user story...') was removed and merged into the renumbered 'Implement that single user story' step, dropping the list from 13 to 12 items; step 8 ('Update the PRD to set passes:true for the completed story') and every step after it were left semantically unchanged (only renumbered). While making the two copies byte-identical over the '## Your Task' .. '## Stop Condition' span (this story's AC3 oracle), I also fixed pre-existing unrelated drift between them that predated this story: a 'you're'/'you are' wording mismatch and a stale Step-5.5 cross-reference (templates copy pointed at '.claude/commands/cam-next.md', which no longer documents Step 5.5; canonicalized both to 'the agent SYSTEM PROMPT', matching the scripts copy). Ran `bun run embed-vendor` + `embed-vendor:check` (clean) since templates/ changed. All PRD stories in this PRD (US-001, US-002) now have passes:true and no non-operator story remains — the next agent invocation should find prd.json fully passing and the PRD in review/ship territory, not another implement story.
